title: SM-16.06 - Can external users create new surveys after 31 August 2026
intent: This article answers: SM-16.06 - Can external users create new surveys after 31 August 2026
short_answer: No. From 31 August 2026, external users will not be able to create new surveys themselves on the Commission-hosted EUSurvey service. Survey creation must be performed by an EU institutional user, who may then grant the external user appropriate management permissions.
important_conditions: Continued external-user involvement must take place under EU institutional responsibility.
